blocks.expression: Narrowed appraising eyes beneath a faintly raised left brow, lips pressed into a thin measured line, shoulders squared and held close, chin tipped a fraction downward in guarded, unconvinced appraisal.
blocks.crew_palette: Subtle violet rim-light grazing the blazer shoulder seam and catching a small violet enamel collar pin tucked just above the rank bars.
blocks.grade_cue: Three narrow brushed-steel rank bars stacked vertically at the blazer collar point.
